messages:
Maya: quick pass on the Compliance > Data Controls page — attaching screenshot and a tiny Loom: https://loom.redwood/example
Priya: thanks — main things i saw: retention dropdown feels buried, the KMS label is ambiguous, and audit log event names look too technical.
Jared: can you call out exact spots? i'll check CSS/DOM for tabindex stuff.
Maya: 1) retention selector is below the fold on small screens — should it move up near the toggle? 2) label currently reads 'Retention (days)'; curious if 'Auto-delete after' is clearer. 3) KMS badge says 'Customer key' vs 'Redwood key' — customers asked for "BYOK" language.
Priya: agree re order. propose layout change: put Retention row right under Data location and show current value inline.
Priya: microcopy proposals: a) label: "Auto-delete after" b) helper: "Data removed after the selected period; retained for compliance exports until purge."
Avery: prefer simpler helper. suggestion: "Data will be permanently deleted after the chosen period." then add a tooltip for details.
Sam: accessibility nit — the retention dropdown needs aria-live when value changes (so screen reader notifies the change). Also keyboard focus order should go: toggle -> region -> retention -> KMS.
Jared: noted. current DOM order is toggle -> KMS -> region -> retention (oops). will reorder.
Maya: KMS wording: customers get confused between 'Customer key' and 'BYOK'. maybe show 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)' and on hover: 'You manage the key; Redwood never sees key material.'
Avery: +1. also icon contrast for the lock badge is failing color contrast 3:1 on light theme per design-bot.
design-bot: a11y check: "lock-badge.svg" contrast ratio 2.6:1 (fail). Recommend #1E2A3F for icon color or use outline + text label.
Sam: for screen readers, the KMS toggle should announce who owns the key: "Using customer-managed key. Redwood does not have key access." short and clear.
Maya: audit log copy: right now events are like `data.purge_triggered` and `kms.rotate`. UX wants friendly phrases in the UI: 'Retention purge executed' and 'Key rotated'.
Avery: i'd prefer human-readable event label + machine id in details. e.g., show 'Retention purge executed' and quietly expose `data.purge_triggered` in the event payload or expandable details.
Jared: backend already stores both. we'll surface friendly text by default and keep raw event type in the JSON view.
Maya: timestamp format: audit log currently shows UTC epoch-ish. users want local tz + relative time. propose: "Mar 02 2025, 09:34 PST — 5m ago" display.
Priya: ensure there's a timezone indicator and an option to switch to UTC in the table header.
Sam: keyboard table: make rows focusable and ensure the details expansion is reachable via Enter/Space. add `aria-expanded` state toggles.
Avery: microcopy tweak for the retention confirm modal: current 'Are you sure?' is weak. propose: "Permanently delete data after [X days]? This action cannot be undone." add link to policy.
Maya: also consider a soft-warning for long-retention customers: "Long retention may increase storage costs and incident surface." small copy under the selector.
Jared: will sketch DOM changes and drop PR; can someone review the copy before I ship?
Avery: i'll do a copy pass tomorrow morning.
Priya: i'll update the mock and include small-screen view.
Sam: i'll run an a11y sweep after the mock; ping me when the branch is ready.
infra-bot: reminder: staging deploy scheduled 03/08 02:00 UTC — include feature flag `compliance-ui-redo`.
Maya: thanks all — created follow-up issues: https://tracker.redwood/r/COMP-421 and COMP-422 for audit copy + retention flow. tagging Priya/Avery/Sam/Jared for reviews. :thumbsup:
